faq.title: Questions we expect, answered.
faq.q1: How is this different from asking a chatbot?
faq.a1: A chatbot can invent programmes, amounts and deadlines. In Nexa, fixed rules decide who is eligible, every match lists its reasons, and Gemma 4 only reads documents, explains results and writes. It can only recommend opportunities from the list.
faq.q2: Why do I need an account?
faq.a2: So your company profile, what you need and your deal tracker are there when you come back. In this demo the account lives in your browser only.
faq.a3: A pitch deck or company profile as PDF, PowerPoint (.pptx), Word (.docx), an image or plain text. Gemma 4 turns it into a profile you check and edit.
faq.q4: Does it cover all 11 ASEAN countries?
faq.a4: Yes, including Timor-Leste, which became the 11th member in October 2025. The demo dataset has opportunities in every member state.
faq.a5: English, Bahasa Melayu, Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese, Tamil, Thai, Vietnamese, Filipino, Khmer, Lao, Burmese and Tetun. Ask Nexa answers in whatever language you write in.
faq.q6: How does this help Startup ASEAN?
faq.a6: Every saved, applied and signed opportunity is a signal. Together they show which programmes turn connections into deals, and where founders drop off.
